                                           ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OP THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I . Title 17 of thc Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is

hereby amended by changing all of the Ml-1 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-J in thc area bounded by

           The public alley next north of and parallel to West Potomac Avenue; The
           Chicago, Milwaukee, St Paul and Pacific Railroad; a line 259.5 feet east of the
           east line ofNorth Monticello Avenue; West Potomac Avenue; a line 90.0 feet east
           ofthe east line ofNorth Monticello Avenue

to those of a C l - l Neighborhood Commercial District.


SECTION 2. Tliis ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



Common Street Address:          3600 W. Potomac Avenue




928108.2
                                            Narrative and Plans

                                             Type 1 Zoning
                                              Narrative for
                                       3600 West Potomac Avenue
                                             Ml-2 toCl-1



           A. The applicant proposes to rezone the subject property from Ml-2 Limited
           Manufacturing/Business Park District to C l - l Neighborhood Commercial District. The
           subject property is currently improved with a 2-story building. The purpose of the zoning
           amendment is to permit the applicant to occupy the existing building with manufacturing,
           production and industrial uses permitted in the Cl district, a children's play center on the
           first floor and one residential unit on the second floor.

           B. Lot Area                                  19,015 square feet

           C. FAR                                       1.2

           D. Number of Dwelling Units                  1 dwelling unit

           E. Density (Lot area per dwelling unit)      19,000 square feet - 1 DwelUng Unit

           F. Building Height                          Not to exceed existing building height

           G. Front setback (Potomac)                  C
           H. Side setback (East)                      0'
           I. Side setback (West)                      19'
           1. Rear Setback                             0'
           J. Parking                                  5 parking spaces



           *Pursuant to Section 17-3-0307 Exceptions, the applicant will comply with the Air
           Quality Ordinance, if applicable.
